title: Plan
intro: Work streams, their programs and projects, each with an owner. Everyone can read the plan; owners edit what they own and everything below it, and administrators edit everything.
emptyHint: An administrator creates the first work stream.
emptyHintCreate: Create the first work stream to start planning.

announce.expandedAll: Every work stream and program expanded
announce.collapsedAll: Every work stream and program collapsed

filter.search: Search work streams, programs and projects
filter.noneHint: Change or clear the filters to see rows again.

order.off: Reordering is off while a search, an owner filter or "Show only this" is on: clear it to move work streams or programs.
order.stale: The plan changed in the meantime, so the new order was not saved and the plan was reloaded. Make the change again if you still want it.
order.forbidden: Only an administrator can reorder work streams, and only a work stream's owner or an administrator its programs
order.announceUnchanged: {{name}} dropped where it was, position {{position}} of {{count}}
order.announceOutside: {{name}} dropped outside its list, nothing changed

print.filtered: Filtered view: not every row of the plan is shown.

ownerHint: Owners edit this and everything below it, and can hand it over to someone else.
saveForbidden: You are not allowed to change this
saveInvalid: One or more fields are invalid — check the owner and the dates
saveGone: This no longer exists — reload the page

validation.descriptionLength: Description must be at most 500 characters
validation.endBeforeStart: The end must not be before the start
validation.windowBoth: Set both target dates or neither

workStream.endDateHint: Set only when the work stream is closed. Clear it to reopen.
workStream.saveConflict: A work stream with this name already exists
workStream.deleteConflict: This work stream still has programs. Delete them first.

program.saveConflict: A program with this name already exists
program.deleteConflict: This program still has projects. Delete them first.

project.fieldsReadOnly: Only the project's owner, an owner above it or an administrator can change these fields.
project.windowReadOnly: Only an administrator, an owner above the project or a roadmap editor can change the target window.
project.saveConflict: A project with this name already exists in this program
project.deleteConflict: This project cannot be deleted right now.

move.programLine: Program {{name}} is currently in work stream {{parent}}.
move.noProgramTargets: There is no other program to move this project to. You can move a project only into a program where you could create one.
move.noStreamTargets: There is no other work stream to move this program to. You can move a program only into a work stream where you could create one.
move.projectConflict: A project with this name already exists in that program — pick another program.
move.targetGone: That target no longer exists. The plan was reloaded — pick another.
move.forbidden: You are not allowed to move this there any more. The plan was reloaded.
move.failed: The move failed. Check your connection and try again.
